This '''scavenger''' was a criminal in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] who sold parts scavenged from destroyed [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he sent an [[Lizard boy|underling]] to steal [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[plasma ignition capacitor]] just minutes before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] began. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] chased the underling back to the scavenger. Refusing to return the capacitor, he challenged Jinn to take it from him, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a firefight with the Jedi Master, who returned the stolen part to Skywalker in time for the race.

==Behind the scenes==
The scavenger appears in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]].
